questions.stem: At the transition temperature $T, A \rightleftharpoons B$ and $\Delta G^{\circ}=105-35 \log T$ where A and B are two states of substance X. The transition temperature in $^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ when pressure is 1 atm is _____ . (Nearest integer)

Consider the following data
(i) $2\,\mathrm{Al}(\mathrm{s})+6\,\mathrm{HCl}(\mathrm{aq}) \rightarrow \mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{Cl}_6(\mathrm{aq})+3\,\mathrm{H}_2(\mathrm{g})+1200\,\mathrm{kJ}/\mathrm{mol}$.
(ii) $\mathrm{H}_2(\mathrm{g})+\mathrm{Cl}_2(\mathrm{g}) \rightarrow 2\,\mathrm{HCl}(\mathrm{g})+164\,\mathrm{kJ}/\mathrm{mol}$.
(iii) $\mathrm{HCl}(\mathrm{g})+\mathrm{aq} \rightarrow \mathrm{HCl}(\mathrm{aq})+83\,\mathrm{kJ}/\mathrm{mol}.$
(iv) $\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{Cl}_6(\mathrm{s})+\mathrm{aq} \rightarrow \mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{Cl}_6(\mathrm{aq})+663\,\mathrm{kJ}/\mathrm{mol}.$
The enthalpy of formation of anhydrous solid $\mathrm{Al}_2\mathrm{Cl}_6$ is :

Gas 'A' undergoes change from state 'X' to state 'Y'. In this process, the heat absorbed and work done by the gas is 10 J and 18 J respectively. Now gas is brought back to state 'X' by another process during which 6 J of heat is evolved. In the reverse process of 'Y' to 'X',

options.label: A
options.content: 18 J of the work is done by the gas 'A'.

options.label: B
options.content: 2 J of the work is done by the gas 'A'.

options.label: C
options.content: 12 J of the work is done on the gas 'A' by the surrounding.

options.label: D
options.content: 14 J of the work is done on the gas 'A' by the surrounding.
